mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM user_role ur JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, code, name, type, parent_id, sort, create_time FROM `permission` ORDER BY id
